title: Sopapilla Cupcakes
description: Sopapilla cupcakes, reminiscent of the Mexican-inspired dessert, are sweet cinnamon-and-sugar cupcakes topped with honey-and-cinnamon frosting.
ingredients: 3 cups confectioners' sugar, or more as needed

steps.text: Preheat the oven to 325 degrees F (165 degrees C). Line 18 muffin cups with paper liners.

Make cupcakes: Mix together cake mix, water, egg whites, oil, 1 tablespoon cinnamon, vanilla, and lemon extract in the bowl of a stand mixer; mix on low for 30 seconds. Increase speed to medium and mix batter for 2 minutes. Fill prepared muffin cups 2/3-full with batter.
Combine white sugar and remaining 1 tablespoon cinnamon in a small bowl; sprinkle over batter.
Bake in the preheated oven until a toothpick inserted into a cupcake comes out clean, about 15 minutes. Cool cupcakes to room temperature.

Make frosting: Beat butter in a large bowl with an electric mixer until creamy and fluffy, 1 to 2 minutes. Add confectioners' sugar, 3 tablespoons honey, and cinnamon; beat until just combined. Mix milk, 1 tablespoon at a time, into creamed butter mixture until desired consistency is reached.
Spoon frosting into a piping bag or a plastic bag with a snipped corner; pipe onto each cupcake. Drizzle 1 tablespoon honey over frosted cupcakes.

video.description: The classic Mexican deep-fried cinnamon & sugar treat is transformed into deliciously indulgent and fluffy spiced cupcakes! Mix a white cake mix with water, egg whites, oil, cinnamon, vanilla and lemon extract to create the muffin batter, pour into muffin cups and top with a sprinkling of cinnamon sugar. Once baked, top with honey buttercream of butter, confectioners’ sugar, honey, cinnamon and milk. To serve, drizzle honey over the frosting, and if you want to make them extra special, insert a garnish of genuine sopapilla!
